# Format release-note pull requests

Use when formatting, rewriting, or reviewing a pull request whose title and complete description become release
notes. First read the [authoring guide](../../../../../docs/content/guides/formatting-release-note-prs.md);
it owns the release-record content, replay check, evergreen-documentation boundary, and validation.
The linked [MSX PR format](https://msx.no/docs/Ways-of-Working/PR-Format/) owns the shared title and description structure.

If the repository-relative guide is unavailable from an installed plugin, read its
[published page](https://psmodule.io/docs/guides/formatting-release-note-prs/) instead.

## Agent-specific contract

- Read the target repository's instructions and PR template before editing its metadata.
- Apply the guide's authoring and replay checks to the full delivered range.
- Report the edited PR URL, relevant baseline, verified impact, and validation outcomes to the owning session.
- Stop and report when the cited guidance or required source evidence is unavailable; identify the evidence gap.
